name: method-meta-muon
preserved: Independent prelude/coda surround a shared sparse middle stack.
Fixed loop depth, full BPTT and terminal CE; parameter/sparsity/data facts are reported separately.
adaptations: Original routing is replaced by common softmax top-k routing.
Original dispatch/capacity handling is replaced by dropless dispatch.
Original optimizer background is replaced by Track P2's Muon for hidden matrices (AdamW for embedding, head, routers, norms and other 1-D parameters).
Embedding and output head are independently owned in the common stack.
Publicly reconstructible DCLM replaces the original private corpus; the frozen manifest and tokenizer are separate comparison identities.
Common RMSNorm/RoPE/SwiGLU cells, softmax top-k with selected-weight normalization and dropless dispatch.

Track P2's Muon for hidden matrices (AdamW for embedding, head, routers, norms and other 1-D parameters) and independently owned input embedding/output head; no original-paper quality or scaling claim.

Geometry: prelude and coda of 2 layers instead of 1 give m0's 12 logical layers (2 + 2 x 4 + 2), so the KV matches at P2's width and heads, and 130 experts per layer instead of 64 give m0's unique parameters with 6 physical layers.

Matrix initialization std=.02 and unit norm scales are P2's; seq 4096, 1,048,576 positions per update, the schedule (95-update linear warmup, constant peak, last 20% linear to 0) and the AdamW or Muon settings are Track P2's; the training recipe (objective, depth, aux coefficient, expert LR multiplier) is the constructor's.
